tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Fetch a URL and extract structured data, paying in USDC via x402 (production networks). mode "fetch" (default) returns title/description/text; "links" returns outbound links; "images" returns image sources + alt text; "metadata" returns all meta tags + response headers. Call without paymentHeader fi

tools.name: extract_links
tools.description: Convenience wrapper around run_query with mode="links" — fetches a URL and returns every outbound link, resolved to absolute URLs and deduped. Same price and payment flow as run_query.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Pay in USDC via x402 to download a file previously stored via POST /api/storage/upload. Call without paymentHeader first to receive the price + payment requirements.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Store a small text payload as a file, paying in USDC via x402. For binary uploads, use the REST endpoint directly instead of this tool.

tools.name: get_ad_impression
tools.description: Pay a fraction of a cent in USDC via x402 to retrieve an ad payload for a given adId.

tools.name: list_ads
tools.description: Free — list currently active ads available for paid impressions.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Free — register to get an agentId used for attribution on paid calls.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Free — list the most recently registered agents.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Free — look up a single registered agent by id.

tools.name: extract_images
tools.description: Convenience wrapper around run_query with mode="images" — fetches a URL and returns every image source (resolved to absolute URLs) with alt text, deduped. Same price and payment flow as run_query.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Convenience wrapper around run_query with mode="metadata" — fetches a URL and returns all meta tags (Open Graph, Twitter Card, standard) plus a few response headers. Same price and payment flow as run_query.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_query, download_file, get_metadata · Private data: download_file, upload_file · Public sink: download_file, upload_file · Destructive: run_query.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_query, download_file, get_metadata · Private data: download_file, upload_file · Public sink: download_file, upload_file · Destructive: run_query

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
